title: Leiri- ja kurssikeskusvaraukset
description: Kesälukioseura järjestää Suomessa asuville pakolaislapsille ja -nuorille leirimuotoisia oman äidinkielen ja kulttuurin kursseja. Kesälukioseura etsii vuoden 2027 kursseja varten leiri- ja kurssikeskuksia eri puolilta Suomea. Kurssit ajoittuvat koulujen loma-ajoille (talvilomaviikko 8, kesä–heinäkuu). Oman äidinkielen ja kulttuurin kursseja järjestetään 8–9 (1–2 talvella, seitsemän kesällä). Kesän kurssit ovat pituudeltaan vajaan viikon mittaisia (5 vrk, esim. ma–la). Talvilomaleirin kesto on 4 vrk, ma-pe. Kursseille osallistuu noin 20–32 iältään 7–14-vuotiasta lasta sekä 4–7 omakielistä opettajaa. Jokaiselle osallistujalle pitää olla leirin aikana vuodepaikka (ei patjamajoitusta). Kesälukioseura vastaa kurssien järjestämisestä. Kurssien ohjaajatiimit vastaavat kurssien opetuksesta ja ohjelmasta. Kurssien järjestämisestä aiheutuvat kulut katetaan sosiaali- ja terveysministeriön myöntämällä avustuksella. Avustusta haetaan vuosittain, ja vuoden 2027 avustuspäätös selviää alkuvuodesta 2027. Hankinnan vertailuperusteina ovat turvallisuus, kokonaisedullisuus, luonnonläheisyys, kulkuyhteydet, riittävät opetus- ja harrastetilat, majoitus ja ylläpito sekä ajankohta. Tarjouksen voi tehdä yhdestä tai useammasta kurssiviikosta. Tarjouksesta tulee käydä ilmi ajankohta, jota tarjous koskee.

title: Tikkurilan terveys- ja sosiaalikeskuksen lisäpohjatutkimuksen hankinta
description: Tikkurilan terveys- ja sosiaalikeskuksen lisäpohjatutkimuksen hankinta Hankinnan kohteena ovat Tikkurilan uuden terveys- ja sosiaalikeskuksen tontille toteutettavat lisäpohjatutkimukset, joilla täydennetään vuosina 2020–2021 tehtyjä pohjatutkimuksia. Tutkimusten tavoitteena on täydentää hankkeen lähtötietoja, vähentää maaperäolosuhteisiin liittyviä epävarmuuksia sekä tukea kilpailullisen neuvottelumenettelyn aikana tarjoajien suunnittelua ja runkoratkaisujen arviointia. Lisätutkimuksilla tarkennetaan erityisesti maaperän pilaantuneisuutta (PIMA), savikerrosten geoteknisiä ominaisuuksia sekä kallionpinnan ja kallioperän sijaintia. Palvelu sisältää tutkimusten suunnittelun, kenttätutkimusten toteuttamisen sekä tutkimusaineiston toimittamisen tilaajalle sovitussa muodossa. Tutkimukset sisältävät mm. kairauksia, näytteenottoa, pohjavesihavaintoja ja muita geoteknisiä maaperätutkimuksia. Palvelu sisältää myös tarjouspyynnössä edellytettyjen tutkimusten, analyysien ja tutkimusraporttien laatimisen. Tutkimusten tavoitteena on täydentää hankkeen lähtötietoja, vähentää maaperäolosuhteisiin liittyviä epävarmuuksia sekä tukea kilpailullisen neuvottelumenettelyn aikana tarjoajien suunnittelua ja runkoratkaisujen arviointia. Lisätutkimuksilla tarkennetaan erityisesti maaperän pilaantuneisuutta (PIMA), savikerrosten geoteknisiä ominaisuuksia sekä kallionpinnan ja kallioperän sijaintia. Tutkimustulosten hankekokonaisuuden tasoisesta tulkinnasta sekä jatkosuunnittelua tukevista geoteknisistä johtopäätöksistä vastaa tilaajan konsultti. Nyt hankittavien lisäpohjatutkimuksien tavoitteena on varmistaa hankkeen riskienhallinnan ja jatkosuunnittelun tueksi luotettava ja yhtenäinen lähtötietopohja, joka julkaistaan kaikille neuvotteluvaiheessa mukana oleville tarjoajille Hankintayksikkö valitsee yhden (1) toimittajan, jonka kanssa se tekee sopimuksen. Kilpailutuksen perusteella valitaan myös yksi (1) varatoimittaja, jonka kanssa voidaan solmia varsinainen sopimus, mikäli sopimustoimittaja ei täytä sopimuskauden alkaessa tarjouspyynnön ehtoja ja edellytyksiä, tai mikäli sopimustoimittaja ei täytä näitä ehtoja ja edellytyksiä sopimuskauden aikana. title: IRB Digital Case Management TBIPS
description: The Immigration and Refugee Board of Canada (IRB) requires professional services support to the Chief Innovation and Technology Office (CITO) to advance the modernization of the IRB’s current case management application ecosystem through the Digital Case Modernization (DCM) initiative. This support will enable the IRB to define, design, validate, and implement modern digital solutions that improve the sustainability, interoperability, security, and scalability of its case management capabilities. The DCM initiative is intended to address current limitations in the IRB case management environment. Through this requirement, the IRB seeks specialized expertise to support analysis, architecture, technical design, software development, integration, testing, documentation, and knowledge transfer activities required to modernize the platform in a controlled and phased manner. More specifically, the objective is to support the transition of the IRB case management ecosystem toward a modernized, cloud-aligned microservices architecture and operating model that can better support future service improvements, business agility, data sharing, reporting, and the introduction of emerging capabilities such as advanced automation and Artificial Intelligence.

title: Psychiatrist Services Grand Valley Institution – Ontario Region
description: Psychiatrist Services Grand Valley Institution - Ontario Region This requirement is for: The Correctional Service of Canada, Grand Valley Institution in the Ontario Region. Trade agreement: This procurement is not subject to any trade agreement. Policy on Reciprocal Procurement: This solicitation is open only to Canadian suppliers. Competitive Procurement Strategy: compliant bid with the highest technical score. Set-aside under the Procurement Strategy for Indigenous Business: This procurement is not subject to any set-asides for Indigenous Suppliers. Comprehensive Land Claim Agreement: This procurement is not subject to a Comprehensive Land Claims Agreement. Security Requirements: This contract includes security requirements. Nature of Requirements: The following is a summary of the statement of work for this requirement. The Correctional Service of Canada (CSC) Health Services require the services of a licensed physician with a specialty in psychiatry (referred to herein as a psychiatrist) for Grand Valley Institution in the Ontario Region. The Contractor (psychiatrist) will provide psychiatric care services to offenders and collaborate with the inter-disciplinary health services team that includes, but is not limited to Nurses, Pharmacists, Nurse Practitioners, Social Workers, Dietitians, Dentists, Psychologists, and other medical and allied healthcare professionals. Objectives: Provide and actively participate in the coordination of essential mental health services to offenders at Grand Valley Institution as a psychiatrist. Deliverables: The Contractor must provide mental health services to offenders with serious mental illness, as requested by the Project Authority, in accordance with the National Essential Health Services Framework including any amendment to this Framework issued by CSC during the contract period and any optional period if and when exercised by CSC. Any conditions for participation of suppliers not specified in solicitation documentation: none. Estimated quantity of commodity: see solicitation document statement of work and basis of payment. Duration of Contract and Time Frame for Delivery: Period of the Contract: The Work is to be performed during the period of March 1, 2027, to February 28, 2030, inclusively. File Number: 21120-27-5416138 Contracting Authority: Ashley Claessen-Sarault Telephone number: (873) 353-5694 E-mail: ashley.claessen-sarault@csc-scc.gc.ca NOTE TO BIDDERS: Bidders can obtain the complete statement of work and evaluation criteria by downloading the solicitation document and associated documents from the Canada buys / tender opportunities website. The Crown reserves the right to negotiate with suppliers on any procurement. Documents may be submitted in either official language of Canada (English or French) After contract award, bidders may request a debriefing on the results of the bid solicitation process. description: 1. Scope 1.1. Purpose The Canadian Armed Forces (CAF) requires contracted support for the set up of our new office spaces at the Joe Tobie Building in Yellowknife 2nd and 3rd floor 1.2. Background JTFN HQ space require an increase of workstation to accommodate the growth in personnel. This designated POC is the CAF TA (Technical Authority), or representative, for whom the work is being carried out. The TA is responsible for all matters concerning the technical requirements of the work. 4. Deliverables 4.1. The Contractor must provide the services detailed in Section 3 of this Statement of Work. All item locations will be outlined prior to install for which room they all go into. • 10x U- shaped Height Adjustable desk with a file storage pedestal approx. 72W x 96D x 48H • 4 x Bookcase approx. 30W x 12D x 65H • 7x Flip top tables approx. 60W x 24D x 29H • 1x L-Shaped reception desk approx. 72W x 72D x 47H • 19x Mesh back chair with tilt function • 22x Black coat rack • 3x Square coffee table approx. 36W x 36D x 22H • 2x Leather or fabric lounge chair approx. 30W x 33D x 31H • 28x 2 drawer file cabinet on wheels • 14x L-Shaped height adjustable desk approx. 72W x 72D x 48H • 16x Mesh high back-office chair • 3x Square seated height table approx. 36W x 36D x 29H • 17x Mesh back guest chair • 3x Height adjustable desk approx. 70W x 23D x 48H • 36x Mesh high back chair with tilt function • 3x Black leather high back executive office chair • 2x Boardroom table approx. 96W x 48D x 29H • 4x Leather or fabric guest chair • 7x Height adjustable desk approx. 58W x 23D x 48H • 3x flip top table approx. 72W x 24D x 29H questions 1. Solicitation / delivery timeline: The solicitation requires all deliverables to be received on or before October 10, 2026. Could you please confirm the anticipated contract award date and whether the October 10 delivery and installation deadline remains firm? Unfortunately yes the deadline is firm 2. U-shaped height-adjustable desks – Line 1: Could you confirm whether the entire U-shaped workstation is required to be height adjustable, or whether a height-adjustable main desk with fixed return/back credenza would be acceptable, provided the overall workstation meets the required form, dimensions and functionality? Yes that is acceptable 3. Desk orientation: For Line 1 (U-shaped HA desk), Line 4 (L-shaped reception desk), and Line 10 (L-shaped HA desk), are specific left/right bridge or return orientations required? Appendix 1 does not appear to identify the furniture orientation. Would reversible configurations be acceptable, or will the required orientation be confirmed with the Technical Authority prior to installation? The orientation will be confirmed with the Technical Authority at contract award 4. Furniture finishes: Other than the colors specifically identified in the SOW, are there any required finishes, laminate types, colors or branding standards for the furniture? In particular, is HPL required, or may standard commercial laminate finishes be proposed? Besides the finishes listed for the items in the SOW the remaining finishes can be HPL or Standard laminate as long as they are all the same color. 5. Existing room finishes: Are any photographs, finish schedules, or proposed paint/flooring selections available for the 2nd and 3rd floor spaces? If not, may the Offeror propose standard neutral furniture finishes for items where no finish is specified? Yes the offeror can propose furniture finishes. At the moment there is no furniture in the building and walls are just white.

description: VOORAANKONDIGING EUROPESE OPENBARE AANBESTEDING Dit betreft een vooraankondiging waarmee de gemeente Rotterdam de markt vroegtijdig wil informeren over een aankomende opdracht, nog vóórdat de eigenlijke aanbestedingsprocedure formeel van start gaat, zodat geinteresserde ondernemers zich kunnen voorbereiden. Bij een vooraankondiging kunnen partijen zich nog niet aanmelden, nog niet inschrijven, nog geen vragen stellen of formele aanbestedingsdocumentatie inzien. De werkelijke inschrijving kan pas zodra de officiële aanbesteding wordt gepubliceerd. De Bosdreef wordt in twee fasen naar het noorden verlegd om ruimte te maken voor de nieuwe woonwijk Nieuw Kralingen en een bedrijvenstrook. Fase 1 is opgeleverd in 2024. Op of omstreeks 19 juni 2026 wordt de Europese openbare aanbesteding gepubliceerd voor de opgave van fase 2. Het doel van de Opdracht van fase 2 is de realisatie van fase 2 van de Verlegde Bosdreef als volwaardige noordelijke ontsluitingsroute (1x2-baansweg, 50 km/u) ter vervanging van de huidige Bosdreef (thans 2x2-baansweg, 70 km/u). De beoogde startdatum van de werkzaamheden in deze Opdracht fase 2 staat gepland op 1 februari 2027. De Opdracht die in de Europese openbare aanbestedingsprocedure zal worden beschreven gaat over: Nieuw wegtracé (50 km/u-gebiedsontsluitingsweg) met fundering, verharding, markering en wegmeubilair Compleet rioleringssysteem (hemel- en vuilwater) aansluitend op bestaande infrastructuur Operationele VRI's en openbare verlichting Nieuwe, bredere betonnen Crooswijksebrug (niet-beweegbaar) Geïntegreerd infrastructuursysteem Volledige verbinding tussen fase 1 en fase 2 Vergunningen, keuringen, opleverdocumentatie en overdracht aan beheer (RAW-systematiek) Het werk bestaat in hoofdzaak uit : Grondwerk (ontgraven en ophogen inclusief verwerken) Het slopen van een betonnen brug (inclusief fundatie) Het bouwen van een betonnen brug (inclusief fundatie) Het aanbrengen van en grondkering (stalen damwand met verankering) Verwijderen asfaltverharding Aanbrengen asfaltverharding inclusief fundering Aanbrengen elementenverharding inclusief fundering Aanbrengen / installeren van een gemaal Aanleg DIT-riolering / riolering Aanleg persleiding Aanleg waterberging Aanleg verkeersregelinstallaties Aanleg installatie openbare verlichting Bijkomende werkzaamheden De bovenstaande opsomming van werkzaamheden is slechts een indicatie van de te verrichten werkzaamheden en alleen bedoeld om de interesse van potentiële Inschrijvers voor de Europese openbare aanbestedingsprocedure te wekken. Inschrijvers kunnen geen rechten ontlenen aan deze opsomming. Zie voor een nadere technische omschrijving van de uit te voeren werkzaamheden de aanbestedingsleidraad en het daarbij gevoegde RAW-bestek zoals dat op of omstreeks 19 juni 2026 zal worden gepubliceerd via dit Aanbestedingsplatform.

description: Le CEA projette la construction d’un bâtiment d’extension d’une installation existante sur le centre de Valduc. Afin de garantir la parfaite préparation de l’emplacement retenu, le CEA souhaite, à travers le marché objet de ce présent avis, réaliser les travaux préparatoires nécessaires à l’aménagement de la zone de construction. Ces travaux correspondent aux prestations suivantes : - L’aménagement de la zone de chantier ; - La dépose et le dévoiement de réseaux existants sur la zone ; - Le réaménagement du merlon situé sur le bâtiment adjacent au futur bâtiment, y compris la dépose d’ouvrages existants ; - La réalisation de la plateforme du futur bâtiment et des futures bases vies pour la phase travaux ; - L’évacuation sur le site des matériaux de déblais excédentaires ; - L’amenée de tous les réseaux nécessaires (dont Eaux Usées, Eaux Industriels, Eau Potable, Infrastructures pour Courants Forts et Courants Faibles Industriels). Les travaux du présent Marché correspondent aux travaux préparatoires préalables à la construction d’une extension d’un Bâtiment existant. Ces travaux comprennent en part ferme : • La zone d’installation chantier du Titulaire, y compris signalisation de chantier, • La réalisation des éléments assurant la délimitation de la future zone chantier qui comprend : o L’implantation des limitations des futurs ouvrages o La mise en place de clôtures et de barrières de protection o La réalisation de la plateforme et des sujétions associées au futur poste de gardiennage, y compris réseaux secs et humides • La dépose et/ou dévoiement de réseaux secs et humides (dont EP, EI, AEP, CFO, CFI,) • Le réaménagement du merlon du bâtiment existant avec les sujétions associées dont notamment : o La dépose du merlon (environ 7500m3) o La dépose d’ouvrages d’existants en béton armé (ouvrages de soutènement et galerie extérieure) o La réalisation de nouveaux ouvrages de soutènement en béton armé pour le merlon en toiture sur 50ml environ o La mise en bardage du voile extérieur du bâtiment existant, y compris toutes sujétions (60m x 12m environ) • L’aménagement de la plateforme de la future extension (environ 1500 m3 de déblai) (profondeur d’environ 1m) • L’aménagement de la zone des bases vie pour une surface approximative de 1300m² • L’évacuation des matériaux de déblai (zone de dépose sur le site à 1.5 km en aller simple) • La mise en place des réseaux, postes et équipements électriques pour le futur chantier depuis le bâtiment existant (1 armoire de distribution générale de chantier alimentant les bases vie, les grues et les coffrets de chantier) • La mise en place des arrivées de réseaux secs et humides pour les futures bases vies de chantier • La dépose et l’évacuation du poste électrique HT/BT existant et présent sur l’emprise chantier ainsi que les structures associées, y compris liaisons électriques • Un suivi géotechnique de type mission G3 • La pose de candélabres sur poteau bois avec haut-parleurs (environ une dizaine) • L’établissement de tous les documents nécessaires à la bonne exécution des travaux (études d’exécution, documents d’organisation de chantier...) mentionnés supra • La réalisation des contrôles et essais à réaliser pour les postes mentionnés supra • Le dossier des ouvrages exécutés Les prestations optionnelles à réaliser au titre du marché sont décrites infra. Les prestations prévues au BPU vont notamment concerner les domaines suivants : • Le détour d’un camion de terre de déblais par l’entrée du centre de Valduc pour contrôle radiologique (distance 6km en aller simple) • L’évacuation sur le site des matériaux de déblais excédentaires • Un arrêt de chantier d’un jour • Un arrêt de chantier d’une semaine ouvrée NOTA 1 : cette liste de prestations prévues au BPU n’est pas exhaustive. NOTA 2 : Les volumes précisés supra correspondent à des quantités estimées par le CEA. Elles ne constituent pas un engagement du CEA. Les prestations optionnelles du marché sont les suivantes : • L’agrandissement du bassin d’orage (130m3 maximum) • Alimentation des bases vie depuis un futur poste HT BT (hors périmètre de ce marché) (environ 200ml) Les prestations se déroulent sur le Centre CEA/DAM de VALDUC en Zone Protégée avec contraintes d’accès et d’exploitation.

title: Guatemala – Research and development services and related consultancy services – Asistencia Técnica para la implementación de la Agenda de inversiones Global Gateway en Guatemala – Global Gateway Facility Guatemala
description: En 2021, la Comisión Europea lanzó la estrategia de inversiones Global Gateway, que tiene como objetivo fomentar inversiones de gran calibre en infraestructura verde y digital en los países socios, con soluciones innovadoras y de calidad, creando al mismo tiempo valor añadido local y promoviendo el crecimiento económico, el empleo y la cohesión social. Durante la III Cumbre UE-CELAC, celebrada en julio de 2023, los dirigentes de ambas regiones reafirmaron su compromiso de reforzar la asociación birregional, reconociendo la importancia de la Agenda de Inversiones Global Gateway. Dicho compromiso fue renovado durante la IV Cumbre UE-CELAC celebrada en noviembre de 2025. El objetivo general de esta acción es contribuir a la implementación de inversiones sostenibles y transformadoras en los sectores de transición verde y digital en Guatemala, donde haya un interés común europeo y de la agenda de desarrollo de Guatemala, y ello en el marco de la Agenda de Inversión Global Gateway, asegurando su alineación con las prioridades estratégicas del país y fomentando un desarrollo inclusivo y sostenible. La Asistencia Técnica contribuirá a: mejorar la alineación, coordinación y monitoreo de las iniciativas implementadas en el marco de la Agenda de Inversión Global Gateway en Guatemala; promover un marco regulatorio e institucional que favorezca la inversión sostenible en los sectores prioritarios de la Agenda de Inversión Global Gateway; impulsar proyectos de inversión sostenibles, transformadores y sensibles a la igualdad de género y a las buenas prácticas internacionales en materia de derechos y protección del medioambiente en los sectores prioritarios y a posicionar los intereses del sector privado europeo en el marco de la Agenda de Inversión Global Gateway para Guatemala. Sin excluir otras potenciales áreas de trabajo prioritarias para la UE y Guatemala, y reconociendo la flexibilidad dinámica de la estrategia Global Gateway, las áreas prioritarias para Guatemala actualmente incluyen transición verde (transporte sostenible, energía renovable e integración eléctrica regional, economía circular, gestión sostenible de recursos naturales y residuos) y transición digital (conectividad, gobernanza digital, ciberseguridad, innovación digital, observación de la Tierra, inteligencia artificial).

title: eContent Books RFI
description: The United States Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) is a Cabinet-level executive branch department of the Federal Government whose workforce is comprised of approximately 650,000 clinical and non-clinical personnel (of which approximately 450,000 are employees) charged with providing lifelong healthcare services to eligible military veterans at the 1,380 health care facilities, including 170 VA medical centers and 1,193 outpatient sites located throughout the country. Non-healthcare benefits include disability compensation, vocational rehabilitation, education assistance, home loans, and life insurance. The VA also provides burial and memorial benefits to eligible veterans and family members at the 157 VA managed or 125 VA grant-funded cemeteries. VA employs a highly skilled and multi-faceted workforce aligned with its mission, program, and operational needs. Workforce Development is one of the key factors to recruiting and retaining a high-performing workforce. VA employs individuals at every competency and skill level whether they are new to the workforce or experts in their occupation. That said, VA workforce needs differ at every career stage. VA Federal personnel are encouraged annually to complete My Development Plans (MDP). They work with supervisors to determine short and long- term career goals as well as short-term training needs. Training needs are then documented on the MDP. The VA�s Leadership Development Framework (LDF) is based on the Federal-wide United States Office of Personnel Management Executive Core Qualifications. By using the VA LDF, VA personnel will be better able to assess their leadership capabilities for developmental purposes and to support the Department�s workforce, talent development, and succession planning efforts. Certain VA Mission Areas, Agencies, and Staff Offices require its workforce to complete technical competency assessments and leadership competency assessments for non-supervisory positions. VA personnel will complete leadership and technical competency assessments through the Department�s Talent Management System (TMS) 2.0 or Learning Management system of record (LMS). VA personnel must also meet certain training requirements throughout the year. These requirements may be prescribed as Federal Mandatory Training such as No Fear Act, Information Security Awareness, Occupational Health, and Safety, or Telework. Some personnel must complete training required by their occupation or role such as Cyber security role-based training. VA personnel access most of their training through Talent Management System TMS 2.0. This platform provides a common LMS and learning content services that enable VA to maximize the return on taxpayer investment. TMS 2.0 has a robust and secure environment to accommodate approximately 450,000 end users, ~12,000 administrators and over 500 unique domains. TMS 2.0 is the Department-wide system for managing training records and activities at VA. The purpose of this contract is to acquire eContent, Digital Books, Professional Development Training and Support Services to meet the training requirement of VA.

description: The Contractor shall furnish all labor, supervision, materials, supplies, equipment, tools, and transportation required for maintaining six elevators, in a continuously safe, reliable, and satisfactory operating condition and to perform all inspections and testing as required. Five (5) elevators are located at Naval Air Station Meridian, MS, and one (1) elevator is located at Outlying Joe Williams Field in Kemper County, MS. The Contractor will provide recurring monthly services, periodic testing, and non-recurring on-demand repair services to the Government in exchange for compensation. The Contractor must conduct operations in compliance with the American Society of Mechanical Engineers Safety Code for Elevators and Escalators (ASME A17 series), the contract Performance Work Statement (PWS), and all applicable state, local, and federal laws.

title: Pakistan NDC 3.0 Delivery Coordination Mechanism (Federal-Provincial Coordination and Tracking)
description: The UK Government's Partnering for Accelerated Climate Transitions (UK PACT) programme is inviting proposals from qualified suppliers or consortia to deliver technical assistance to the Government of Pakistan. Pakistan has committed to reducing projected greenhouse gas emissions by 50% by 2035 through its Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC) 3.0. Delivering this target will depend heavily on action at the provincial level, where responsibility for many climate-relevant sectors rests. While the Government of Pakistan has established new coordination arrangements through the National Climate Finance Strategy (NCFS), challenges remain around federal-provincial coordination, implementation tracking, climate finance visibility, and reporting progress against national climate commitments. The assignment will provide targeted technical assistance to support the Ministry of Climate Change and Environmental Coordination (MoCC&EC), the Pakistan Climate Change Authority (PCCA), and provincial governments to establish and operationalise a practical federal-provincial coordination and tracking mechanism for NDC 3.0 implementation. The project will strengthen institutional coordination, improve monitoring and reporting of climate actions and investments, build government capacity, and support the mobilisation of climate finance. The intervention will also integrate Gender Equality, Disability and Social Inclusion (GEDSI) considerations to promote more inclusive climate governance and decision-making. Key outputs are expected to include a federal-provincial NDC coordination framework, a standardised NDC tracking and reporting framework, an interoperability pilot connecting existing government climate and public-sector data systems, operational support for a Tactical Climate Coordination Forum, and a sustainability and scale-up roadmap. The project aims to strengthen Pakistan's ability to implement and report on its climate commitments, improve evidence-based decision-making, enhance transparency and accountability, and create a stronger foundation for attracting climate finance and accelerating NDC delivery across provinces and sectors. Interested suppliers are invited to review the documentation provided in this notice, and submit their applications to: targetedfund@ukpact.co.uk.

title: Precision Inertial Navigation & Positioning On an Integrated Tesseract (PINPOINT)
description: The Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency (DARPA) is soliciting innovative proposals in the following technical area: physics and nonlinear control of inertial measurement units (IMUs) appropriate for tactical and unmanned missions. The Precision Inertial Navigation & Positioning On an Integrated Tesseract (PINPOINT) program will challenge the research community to overcome the decade-long performance plateau of micro-electro-mechanical systems (MEMS) IMUs by exploring revolutionary sensor architectures that operate in highly nonlinear regimes. DARPA is soliciting proposals for the research and development of novel inertial sensors based on physics such as, but not limited to, electromagnetically levitated proof masses, non-linear resonators, and high-velocity tethered microsystems. A central theme of this program is the tight co-design of the physical sensor package with advanced, real-time adaptive control systems necessary to stabilize and harness these complex dynamics. Performers should investigate innovative approaches that enable revolutionary advances in science, devices, or systems. Specifically excluded is research that primarily results in evolutionary improvements to the existing state of practice.

title: Measurement of Benzene Emissions from Gasoline Dispensing Facilities
description: Environment and Climate Change Canada (ECCC)’s mandate includes the preservation and enhancement of the quality of the natural environment, including water, air and soil quality. Accordingly, ECCC works in conjunction with Health Canada (HC) and other departments to understand the risks posed by the release of toxic substances, then develop policy as needed to effectively manage these releases. Benzene is recognized as a human carcinogen by HC (Canada 1993) and the International Agency for Research on Cancer (IARC) (IARC 2018), among other international agencies. In addition, short-term exposure (over hours to days) is associated with hematotoxicity, including during fetal development. Benzene is a constituent of gasoline and, as a volatile organic compound (VOC), readily evaporates and is released into the atmosphere from gasoline service stations. Exposure to benzene through inhalation of emissions from these facilities may pose unacceptable risks to human health for members of the general population residing in the vicinity of gasoline stations. ECCC wishes to study benzene concentrations in the air in the vicinity of gasoline stations Canada, ideally in the Ottawa-Gatineau area, to improve understanding of the human health implications of benzene emissions from these facilities and validate the efficacy of emissions control equipment in cases where it is installed. The contractor will contribute to this objective by measuring ambient concentrations of benzene and, where feasible, other VOCs or total VOCs at gasoline stations before, during, and after gasoline deliveries, in accordance with the parameters set out in this Statement of Work. The Contractor must perform and complete the Work within the period commencing upon notification of acceptance of the offer and ending no later than March 31, 2027. For additional information, interested suppliers should contact Helena Lee at; Helena.Lee@ec.gc.ca.

title: Flood Bank Realignment
description: This collaborative project with SBAG address recurring concerns over beaver burrowing and floodbank breaches on high-value farmland along the River Isla, a major tributary of the River Tay (SAC). By realigning a floodbank and creating a wider more natural river corridor with willow buffer strip we intend to increase bank resilience, reduce beaver impacts and enhance biodiversity. Two participating agricultural landowners will trial setback embankments and habitat features including beaver mounds to encourage coexistence. The approach integrates agricultural resilience with river naturalisation, monitored by the river Restoration Centre and Beaver Trust to inform future coexistence strategies to promote biodiversity.

description: The U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs seeks a Superseding Lease to remain in place utilizing 10,455 Rentable Square Feet (RSF) of Office space for an Oklahoma City Medical Center administrative Office in Oklahoma City, OK. The National Weather Service (NWS), Ocean Prediction Center (OPC), U.S. National Ice Center (USNIC) has a need for georeferenced GeoTIFFs of global coverage in accessible electronic format 24/7/365 and with the capability of near-real-time latency. SAR imagery�s benefits remain helpful to the persistence of USNIC�s operational programs of earth surface observation in the poor weather or illumination conditions of the polar latitudes. Near-real-time latency is considered to be the capability of delivering images deemed to be time critical to USNIC no more than approximately four (4) hours from time of satellite acquisition. Delivery beyond this period prohibits the USNIC from fulfilling an operational requirement to produce timely products and respond to tactical needs. **See attached documents for information being requested and further details**

August 19 2026: Please see amendment 0002 attached and an updated Section L. August 11 2026: 1. Please see amendment 0001 attached and an updated Section L dated 5 August 2026. 2. The government is accepting RFIs until 21 August at 3PM EDT. If you have already sent your RFIs to the POCs you do not have to resubmit them. 4 August 2026: Please see the attached RFP (FA8137-26-R-0040) and all attachments. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- THIS POSTING WILL SATISFY THE REQUIREMENT OF RFO 5.101, Presolicitation Multiple Award Construction Contract (MACC) for General Construction Services will accomplish a broad range of sustainment, maintenance, repair, alteration/renovation, and minor construction projects affecting real property facilities at Tinker Air Force Base, Oklahoma. The work performed will be complex in nature, require multiple construction trades, and may require engineering design performed by credentialed professionals. Project execution methods will fall into one of the following classifications. The execution method will be defined in the project documents for each Task Order (TO) under this Indefinite Delivery Indefinite Quanity (IDIQ) contract. Design Build will include the Contractor providing both the design and construction services for a project; during the Design-Build process, final design solutions are provided by the Contractor, not the Government. The Government will provide a Statement of Work (SOW), drawings, and other preliminary documents to establish requirements from the work to be completed. These documents will be equivalent to a schematic 15% or greater design. When awarded the TO for the project, the Contractor will complete the design to the 100% level to include drawings, specifications, design analysis/narrative, and other documentation as required by the Government. Construction with Limited Design method will include the Government providing the design and the Contractor will further develop portions as required and will provide construction services for the project. This method will be used for non-complex or repetitive work types of projects where design cost and effort is not warranted. The Government will provide the SOW, drawings, and other documents as necessary to establish requirements to complete the project. These documents will be equivalent to a design submittal 35% to 65%. When awarded the TO the Contractor will complete any additional design efforts required by the project and produce a set of working documents for use during construction. Construction only method will include the Government providing 100% design package, including the SOW, drawings, specification, and any other documents as necessary to establish requirements for the work to be accomplished. When awarded the TO the Contractor shall commence with construction in accordance with the design and contract requirements. The Contractor is required to furnish all materials, labor, plant, tools, transportation, equipment, testing services, quality control, and incidentals necessary to provide a complete useable end product as specified in the TO/project documents. The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Code is 236210, Industrial Building Construction with a small business size standard of $45 million. The MACC will be executed for one base period of five (5) years with one option period of five (5) years. The Government will negotiate equitable adjustments resulting from change orders in the shortest practicable time. Approximately 120 days are required to definitize equitable adjustments associated with change orders for construction. The definitization of an equitable adjustment begins when the contracting officer receives an adequate change order definitization proposal and ends when the contracting officer executes a contractual action to definitize the change order. SAR imagery�s benefits remain helpful to the persistence of USNIC�s operational programs of earth surface observation in the poor weather or illumination conditions of the polar latitudes. Near-real-time latency is considered to be the capability of delivering images deemed to be time critical to USNIC no more than approximately four (4) hours from time of satellite acquisition. Delivery beyond this period prohibits the USNIC from fulfilling an operational requirement to produce timely products and respond to tactical needs. **See attached documents for information being requested and further details**

title: Blanket Purchase Agreement - Sample Testing
description: The requirement is for the establishment of single Blanket Purchase Agreements (BPA) for the testing of metal coupons to aid the QA process of the components with which these coupons are associated. The Contractor�s laboratory facility must be validated by the USACE Materials Testing Center (MTC) along with maintain ISO/IEC 17025 certification and remain validated throughout the life of this agreement. Project Background The Contractor shall receive, test mechanical and/or chemical characteristics, and submit reports of coupon materials to aid the QA process of the associated components supplied to the Government via other ongoing contract efforts. The coupons will be shipped directly to the Contractor, many of which will likely come from international locations. The Contractor will not be responsible for shipping or duty costs to receive coupons. The coupon materials that may be tested include but may not be limited to ASTM A743 Grade CA6NM and Grade CF3, ASTM A27 Grade 70-40, ASTM A148 Grade 80-40, ASTM A216 Grade WCC, and ASTM A516 Grade 60. The tests that may be required include chemical analysis according to ASTM A751, carbon combustion according to ASTM E1019-18, tensile tests (yield strength, tensile strength, elongation, and reduction of area) according to ASTM A370, hardness tests according to ASTM A370, and Charpy v-notch impact tests according to ASTM A370. The range of tests completed for a given coupon will depend on the material and component with which it is associated. There may be provisions for optional storage of coupons, both tested and untested. Disposal of excess coupons may be considered at no additional cost to the Government.

description: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), Fort Worth District, on behalf of the Department of the Air Force (DAF), is issuing this solicitation announcement to identify a Design-Build (DB) team for a new Multi-Domain Cyber & Intel Operations Center (MDCIOC) at Joint Base San Antonio (JBSA), Lackland AFB, Texas. title: Mass Properties Measuring Instruments Calibration Services
description: SOURCES SOUGHT TECHNICAL DESCRIPTION INTRODUCTION The United States Army Yuma Proving Ground (USAYPG) is issuing this sources sought notice as a means of conducting market research to identify parties having an interest in and the resources to support the requirement for Mass Properties Measuring Instruments Calibration Services. The intention is to procure these services on a competitive basis. BASED ON THE RESPONSES TO THIS SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE/MARKET RESEARCH, THIS REQUIREMENT MAY BE SET-ASIDE FOR SMALL BUSINESSES (IN FULL OR IN PART) OR PROCURED THROUGH FULL AND OPEN COMPETITION. All Small Business Set-Aside categories will be considered. Telephone inquiries will not be accepted or acknowledged, and no feedback or evaluations will be provided to companies regarding their submissions. Place of Performance: Yuma Proving Ground DISCLAIMER �THIS SOURCES SOUGHT IS FOR INFORMATIONAL PURPOSES ONLY. THIS IS NOT A �REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL (RFP)� or Request for Quote (RFQ). IT DOES NOT CONSTITUTE A SOLICITATION OR A COMMITMENT BY THE GOVERNMENT. Responses do not constitute offers, and the government is not obligated to award a contract. NO FUNDS ARE AVAILABLE TO PAY FOR PREPARATION or submittal OF RESPONSES. the government is not committed or obligated to pay for the information provided, and no basis for claims against the Government shall arise as a result of a response to this Sources Sought INFORMATION SUBMITTED BY RESPONDENTS TO THIS SOURCES SOUGHT IS STRICTLY VOLUNTARY. RESPPONSES WILL NOT BE RETURNED TO THE RESPONDER. NOT RESPONDING TO THIS NOTICE DOES NOT PRECLUDE PARTICIPATION IN ANY FUTURE PROCURMENT ACTION. IT IS THE RESPONSIBILITY OF POTENTIAL OFFERORS TO MONITOR THE GPE FOR ADDITIONAL INFORMMATION PERTAINING TO THIS REQUIREMENT.� PROGRAM BACKGROUND Historically, the U.S. Army Yuma Proving Ground (YPG) utilizes unique precision mass property measurements on artillery and mortar ammunition. Annual calibration services are required in order to maintain traceability to the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST). NIST is the government agency that promotes and maintains measurement standards and is the agency referenced throughout the industry for maintaining traceability. This contract covers on-site repair and annual preventative (PM) services (Parts, Labor, and Travel) for the instruments listed in section 1.3 of the attached PWS at U.S. Army Yuma Proving Ground (YPG), Yuma, Arizona. REQUIRED CAPABILITIES The contractor shall provide calibration services for eight (8) mass property measurement instruments (found in Table 1 of the attached PWS). Calibration must be traceable through NIST and the systems must be tested and compared to the original factory specifications. All services should be conducted in alignment with requirements defined in Part 5 of this PWS. Further detail is provided in the draft Performance Work Statement (PWS) attached to this announcement (Attachment 1_20260825_Draft Mass Properties Measuring Instruments Calibration Service PWS). If your organization has the potential capacity to perform these contract services, please provide the following information: 1) Organization name, address, email address, Web site address, telephone number, and size and type of ownership for the organization; 2) Tailored capability statements addressing the particulars of this effort, with appropriate documentation supporting claims of organizational and staff capability. If significant subcontracting or teaming is anticipated in order to deliver technical capability, organizations should address the administrative and management structure of such arrangements; and The Government will evaluate market information to ascertain potential market capacity to: 1) Provide services consistent, in scope and scale, with those described in this notice and otherwise anticipated; 2) Secure and apply the full range of corporate financial, human capital, and technical resources required to successfully perform similar requirements; and 3) implement a successful project management plan including: compliance with program schedules; cost containment; performance tracking; retention of key personnel, hiring plan to fill gaps and performance risk mitigation. ELIGIBILITY The applicable NAICS code for this requirement is 541380 with a Small Business Size Standard of $19.0 mil. The Product Service Code is J066 Maint/Repair/Rebuild of Equipment � Instruments and Laboratory Equipment. Businesses of all sizes are encouraged to respond; however, each respondent must clearly identify their business size in their capabilities statement. ADDITIONAL INFORMATION AND SUBMISSION DETAILS (CAPABILITIES STATEMENT) Interested parties are requested to submit a capabilities statement of no more than 10 pages in length using 10-point Times New Roman font of not less than 10 pitch. This documentation must address at a minimum the following items: What type of work has your company performed in the past in support of the same or similar requirement? Can or has your company managed a task of this nature? If so, please provide details. Can or has your company managed a team of subcontractors before? If so, provide details. What specific technical skills does your company possess which ensure capability to perform the tasks? Please note that under a Small-Business Set-Aside, in accordance with FAR 52.219-14, the small business prime must perform at least 50% of the work themselves in terms of the cost of performance. Provide an explanation of your company�s ability to perform at least 50% of the tasking described in this PBSOW for the base period as well as the option periods. Provide a statement including current small/large business status and company profile to include number of employees, annual revenue history, office locations, UEI number, etc. Respondents to this notice also must indicate whether they quality as a Small, Small Disadvantaged, Women-Owned, HUBZone, or Service Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business Concern. The proposed contract is subject to include tasking that would be accomplished by labor categories that are subject to the Service Contract Act or a collective bargaining agreement. Upon evaluation of the capability statements, if it is determined that this requirement will be an unrestricted competition, the Government intends to evaluate the Small-Business responses and conduct further market research to identify a subcontracting goal. The deadline for response to this request is no later than 14:00 Mountain Daylight Time (MDT), 25 September 2026. All response under this sources sought notice to include any capabilities statement must be e-mailed to Kristen Long (Contract Specialist) kristen.m.long6.civ@army.mil in either Microsoft Word or Portable Document Format (PDF). All data received in response to this Sources Sought that is marked or designated as corporate or proprietary will be fully protected from any release outside the Government. No phone calls will be accepted All questions must be submitted to the contract specialist identified above. The Government is not committed nor obligated to pay for the information provided, and no basis for claims against the Government shall arise as a result of a response to this sources sought notice.

description: 24 AUG 2026 This notice is being updated to provide additional questions/answers as received by the USG and to issue the attached RFP Amendment 01. Questions from Offerors: 1. Are CMMC requirements required of subcontractors? Per DFARS 252.204-7021(d)(1) (ii) prime contractors are to Consult 32 CFR 170.23 related to the flowdown of the CMMC requirements, and flow down the correct CMMC level to subcontracts and other contractual instruments Per DFARS 252.204-7021(d)(4) Prime contractors are to Ensure all subcontractors and suppliers complete prior to subcontract award, and maintain on an annual basis, an affirmation, by the affirming official (see 32 CFR 170.4), of continuous compliance with the requirements associated with the CMMC level required for the subcontract or other contractual instrument for each of the subcontractor information systems that process, store, or transmit FCI or CUI and that are used in performance of the subcontract Per CFR 107.23 Application to subcontractors (a) CMMC requirements apply to prime contractors and subcontractors throughout the supply chain at all tiers that will process, store, or transmit any FCI or CUI on contractor information systems in the performance of the DoD contract or subcontract. Prime contractors shall comply and shall require subcontractors to comply with and to flow down CMMC requirements, such that compliance will be required throughout the supply chain at all tiers with the applicable CMMC level and assessment type for each subcontract as follows: (1) If a subcontractor will only process, store, or transmit FCI (and not CUI) in performance of the subcontract, then a CMMC Status of Level 1 (Self) is required for the subcontractor. (2) If a subcontractor will process, store, or transmit CUI in performance of the subcontract, then a CMMC Status of Level 2 (Self) is the minimum requirement for the subcontractor. (3) If a subcontractor will process, store, or transmit CUI in performance of the subcontract and the associated prime contract has a requirement for a CMMC Status of Level 2 (C3PAO), then the CMMC Status of Level 2 (C3PAO) is the minimum requirement for the subcontractor. (4) If a subcontractor will process, store, or transmit CUI in performance of the subcontract and the associated prime contract has a requirement for the CMMC Status of Level 3 (DIBCAC), then the CMMC Status of Level 2 (C3PAO) is the minimum requirement for the subcontractor. 2. Can the Government First Article Test Requirements be waived? Yes. Information regarding First Article Test Requirements waivers are provided on Block 11 of the Form 260 attachment to the RFP. In accordance with Block 11, paragraph c., offerors who have previously furnished production quantities of the same or similar articles to the Air Force, provided articles thus furnished, have exhibited satisfactory performance in the opinion of the Air Force; provided not more than 36 months have elapsed since completion of the contract. Under conditions stated in paragraph c., the cognizant engineering activity will decide whether or not the item has exhibited satisfactory performance in service and prepare and retain supporting documentation to fully justify this decision. The following information must be provided for the previously supplied article: Procuring Office, Contract Number, Date of Contract, and Specification Number and Revision. 3. If the First Article Test requirements are waived, will the applicable CDRLs be removed? Yes. Any CDRL applicable to First Article requirements will be removed for offerors who qualify for GFAT waiver. SUBJECT: This is a Request for Proposal for the production of the 20MM Mechanical Housing NSN 1005-01-190-9802. Item Description: NSN: 1005-01-190-9802 P/N: 209F953 The Transfer Unit Mechanical Housing NSN 1005-01-190-9802, P/N 209F953 is the transfer unit attached to the M61A1 gun and is gear-driven by the gun. The transfer unit assembly is attached to the gun feeder. Its function is to transfer live rounds from feed chute to the feeder assembly, and to transfer empty cases from the unload drive assembly into conveyor elements in the return chute. Gear-driven sprocket assemblies and guides within the transfer unit maintain positive control of the rounds and conveyor elements passing through the transfer unit. The transfer unit removes rounds from the conveyor, places the rounds into the extractor lip of the gun breech bolts, receives expended cases and unfired rounds from the gun breech bolts, and places them in the conveyor. The qualification procedures must be approved by the Government engineering activity having jurisdiction over the part in the intended application. If one source is approved, AMCs 3, 4, or 5 are valid. If at least two sources are approved or if data is adequate for an alternate source to qualify in accordance with the design control activity's procedures, AMCs 1 or 2 are valid. Based on critical customer requirements, Defense Logistics Agency Weapons Support (DLA AW) seeks to award a indefinite delivery/indefinite quantity (IDIQ) contract utilizing the strategy listed in Paragraph 2.0 Acquisition Strategy, to satisfy current and future Transfer Unit Housing Assembly requirements, by providing a contract vehicle for production orders issued to mitigate supply chain risks. description: Costituisce oggetto del presente appalto l’affidamento in gestione ad un operatore economico qualificato dei servizi afferenti alla realizzazione delle attività previste dal progetto “DesTEENazione – Desideri in azione”, di cui all’Avviso pubblico adottato con Decreto del Direttore Generale della Direzione Generale per la lotta alla povertà e per la programmazione sociale del Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali prot. n. 69 del 21.03.2024. Il servizio è rivolto a ragazze e ragazzi di età compresa tra gli 11 e i 21 anni residenti o domiciliati nel territorio dell’Ambito Territoriale Sociale e si configura come un sistema integrato di interventi socio-educativi, orientato alla promozione dell’autonomia, della partecipazione attiva, dell’inclusione sociale e dello sviluppo delle competenze personali e relazionali. In particolare, il progetto prevede la realizzazione e gestione di uno spazio multifunzionale ad accesso libero e strutturato, caratterizzato da una forte valenza educativa, aggregativa e partecipativa all’interno del quale dovranno essere garantite attività a libera fruizione e attività strutturate di natura educativa, formativa, laboratoriale e orientativa, nonché azioni di accompagnamento e supporto ai percorsi di crescita personale, formativa e lavorativa dei destinatari.

title: Germany – Engineering design services – Gemeinde Dümmer - Umbau und Sanierung der Kita Seepferdchen
description: Die Gemeinde Dümmer beabsichtigt aufgrund demografischer Veränderungen und bestehender baulicher und brandschutztechnischer Mängel den Umbau und die Sanierung der bestehenden Kindertagesstätte „Seepferdchen“. Derzeit werden alle drei Geschosse des Vorderhauses, ein Teil des hofseitigen Gebäudes und der neue Verbinder von der KITA genutzt. Ein weiterer Teil des hofseitigen Gebäudes wird durch die Gemeinde genutzt. Diese Nutzung soll zukünftig entfallen und der Gebäudeanteil dann der KITA zugeordnet werden. Die geplante Kindertagesstätte ist für die Betreuung von 55 Kindern ausgelegt. Die Zusammenstellung der einzelnen Bereiche stellt sich dabei wie folgt dar: - 10 Krippenkinder - 45 Kindergartenkinder, davon jeweils 3 Gruppen mit je 15 Kindern Gegenstand dieser Ausschreibung sind Ingenieurleistungen gemäß HOAI 2021 Teil 4 Fachplanung, Abschnitt 2 Technische Ausrüstung, Anlagengruppen 4-5, Leistungsphasen 1 - 4, Leistungsphase 5-8 optional (Stufenvertrag) Die Beauftragung der Stufe 1 (LPH 1-4) erfolgt sofort, die Beauftragung der Stufe 2 (LPH 5-8) erfolgt nach Bewilligung von Fördermitteln. Ein Anspruch des Auftragnehmers auf die Beauftragung der Stufe 2 besteht nicht.

title: Denmark – IT services: consulting, software development, Internet and support – Udbud med forhandling af kontrakt om levering, implementering, drift, vedligeholdelse og support af økonomi- og lønsystem til Gribskov Kommune
description: Nærværende udbud vedrører indgåelse af kontrakt om Ordregivers anskaffelse af et integreret økonomi- og lønsystem med særligt fokus på sikker, stabil og effektiv drift. Kontrakten omfatter levering og implementering af løsningen samt den efterfølgende drift, vedligeholdelse og support. Under økonomidelen ligger såvel debitor, opkrævning mv., og under løndelen hører også vagtplan. Driftsydelsen udgør et centralt element i kontrakten, og omfatter det fulde ansvar for løsningens daglige drift, herunder sikring af høj tilgængelighed, performance og driftsstabilitet. Formålet med udbuddet er at etablere en fremtidssikret og robust platform, der understøtter Ordregivers økonomi- og lønadministration effektivt og med høj grad af automatisering, kvalitet og driftssikkerhed, herunder tidssvarende teknologiske muligheder i form af understøttelse af maskinlæring og kunstig intelligens samt andre værktøjer, der kan bidrage til øget automatisering og beslutningsstøtte.

title: Denmark – Construction work – FAB afd. 12, Mosegårdsparken - Hovedentrepriseudbud
description: Disse udbudsbetingelser gælder for realisering af Fyns Almennyttige Boligselskab afd. 12, Mosegården med støtte fra Landsbyggefonden. Udbuddet gennemføres som et begrænset udbud med forudgående prækvalifikation efter udbudslovens § 58-60. Det er således kun de virksomheder, der bliver prækvalificeret af Ordregiver, der vil blive opfordret til at afgive tilbud. Denne opfordring til at afgive tilbud omfatter udelukkende det i disse udbudsbetingelser nævnte bygge- og anlægsarbejde. Fyns Almennyttige Boligselskab er et alment boligselskab underlagt det lovgrundlag og regelsæt, der gælder for almene boligorganisationer. Ordregiver gør opmærksom på, at samtlige projektdokumenter, som fremgår af den fælles dokumentfortegnelse, er en del af udbudsmaterialet. Tilbudsgiver er pligtig til at kontrollere at denne har adgang til det fulde projektmateriale. Tilbudsgiver opfordres til at læse det samlede udbudsmateriale grundigt igennem, da det indeholder de nødvendige informationer for tilbudsafgivelse. Udbudsmaterialet består endvidere af spørgsmål og svar samt eventuelle rettelsesblade, som løbende bliver offentliggjort på udbudsportalen i anonymiseret form. Det udbudte omfatter bygge- og anlægsarbejder i hovedentreprise vedrørende renovering af helhedsplaner for Afd. 12 - Mosegårdsparken Primulavej 1-73, Lathyrusvej 1-89, Monbergsvej 51-59 5000 Odense C. Ordregiver forventer, at kontrakten vil blive indgået i henhold til tidsplanen. Begrundelsen for varigheden af perioden mellem tildelingsbeslutningen og kontraktindgåelsen er ansøgningsprocessen for ydelsesstøtte til renoveringsprojekter, der tildeles af Landsbyggefonden. I perioden mellem tildelingsbeslutning og kontraktindgåelse ansøger Ordregiver herom. Den vindende tilbudsgiver er forpligtet til at bistå Ordregiver med eventuelle oplysninger, såfremt Ordregiver anmoder herom. Der indgås kontrakt med én hovedentreprenør. Som en del af projektmaterialet indgår grundlag for entreprisekontrakt. Det er udelukkende hovedentreprenøren der skal leve op til mindstekravene. Udelukkelsesgrunde: Ordregiver vil udelukke ansøgere der er omfattet af: • De obligatoriske udelukkelsesgrunde i udbudslovens §§ 135, stk. 1-3 og 136. • De frivillige udelukkelsesgrunde i udbudslovens § 137, stk. 1, nr. 1-6. Såfremt en ansøger er omfattet af de obligatoriske eller frivillige udelukkelses-grunde i udbudslovens §§ 135-136 samt 137, stk. 1, nr. 1-6, kan ansøger ved at fremlægge tilstrækkelig dokumentation for sin pålidelighed påvise, at denne alligevel ikke skal udelukkes, jf. betingelserne i udbudslovens § 138. Ordregiver vil i tilfælde af, at den påtænker at udelukke en ansøger, fastsætte en passende frist for fremlæggelse af tilstrækkelig dokumentation for ansøgerens pålidelighed. Rådets forordning (EU) 2022/576 Der kan ikke tildeles kontrakt til følgende virksomheder, jf. Rådets forordning (EU) 2022/576 af 8. April 2022 om ændring af forordning (EU) nr. 833/2014 om restriktive foranstaltninger på baggrund af Ruslands handlinger, der destabiliserer situationen i Ukraine: A. russiske statsborgere eller fysiske eller juridiske personer, enheder eller organer, der er etableret i Rusland B. juridiske personer, enheder eller organer, hvoraf en enhed som omhandlet i nærværende stykkes litra a) direkte eller indirekte ejer over 50 %, eller C. fysiske eller juridiske personer, enheder eller organer, der handler på vegne af eller efter anvisning fra en enhed som omhandlet i nærværende stykkes litra a) eller b), Ligeledes kan der ikke anvendes underleverandører eller støttende enheder, der er omfattet af ovenstående, hvis denne aktørs bidrag udgør mere end 10 % af kontraktværdien. Ordregiver har til hensigt at prækvalificere 5 ansøgere, som vil blive opfordret til at afgive tilbud. Hvis flere end 5 ansøgere opfylder Ordregivers krav til egnethed, udvælger Ordre-giver de 5 ansøgere, der samlet set har dokumenteret den mest relevante og sammenlignelige erfaring i forhold til den udbudte opgave. Ved udvælgelsen lægges der vægt på følgende: • Referencernes relevans i forhold til nærværende projekt, herunder renoveringsomfang, opgavetype og kompleksitet. • Erfaring med hovedentrepriser af sammenlignelig størrelse og kompleksitet. • Erfaring med renoveringsopgaver for almene boligorganisationer. • Erfaring med genhusning, beboerkontakt og arbejder i beboede boliger. • Ansøgers konkrete rolle og ansvar i referenceprojektet. • Referencernes økonomiske størrelse. Referencer med en entreprisesum på minimum 100 mio. kr. ekskl. moms tillægges positiv vægt. Referencer med en entreprisesum på minimum 150 mio. kr. ekskl. moms tillægges særlig positiv vægt. Ved udvælgelsen foretager Ordregiver en samlet vurdering af de afleverede referencers relevans og sammenlignelighed.

title: Italy – Drinks dispensers – Noleggio full service di erogatori di acqua potabile presso gli insediamenti aziendali della Rai di Roma, Milano e Sedi Regionali
description: La presente procedura è finalizzata all’affidamento di un Contratto avente ad oggetto il noleggio “full service”, articolato in n. 2 lotti, di erogatori di acqua potabile presso gli insediamenti aziendali della Rai di Roma, Milano e Sedi Regionali. Ai sensi dell’art. 58 del Codice, la procedura è articolata nei seguenti n. 2 lotti, il cui perimetro è stato definito sulla base di distinti criteri infra dettagliati: Noleggio “full service” di erogatori di acqua potabile presso gli insediamenti aziendali Rai di Roma e Milano Noleggio “full service” di erogatori di acqua potabile presso gli insediamenti aziendali Rai delle Sedi Regionali. Tenuto conto dei principi in materia, il perimetro di ciascun lotto è stato definito applicando un criterio geografico per un bilanciamento tra obiettivi diversi: mantenere una logica di continuità territoriale per la preminente esigenza connessa ad un efficiente gestione della prestazione contrattuale e, al contempo, consentire la partecipazione alle microimprese, piccole e medie imprese (MPMI) in grado di modulare la propria offerta in relazione a potenziali specificità territoriali. In riferimento al Lotto n. 2 delle Sedi Regionali, si è ritenuto di non suddividere ulteriormente i diversi cespiti al fine di conseguire il raggiungimento di elevate economie di scala generate dall’aggregazione della domanda. Il Servizio dovrà svolgersi in esecuzione delle prescrizioni contenute nel Capitolato tecnico nonché di tutti gli ulteriori documenti di gara, tenendo conto, inoltre, di quanto previsto dalla normativa vigente in materia in conformità al Cap. 5 dei Criteri Ambientali Minimi (“CAM”) relativi ai servizi di ristoro e alla distribuzione di acqua di rete a fini potabili, di cui al decreto 6 novembre 2023, adottati con Decreto del Ministero dell’ambiente e della sicurezza energetica del 9 aprile 2025, pubblicati sulla Gazzetta Ufficiale serie generale n. 96 del 26/04/2025. In particolare, l'oggetto dell'appalto consiste nel noleggio full service di erogatori di acqua potabile presso le sedi Rai interessate dall'iniziativa, come infra specificate, secondo le quantità indicate nella Parte 3a Elenco delle apparecchiature del Capitolato Tecnico. Il noleggio comprende, oltre alla messa a disposizione delle apparecchiature, le seguenti attività accessorie e strumentali, il cui valore economico complessivamente considerato è stimato in misura inferiore al 12% dell'importo posto a base di gara per ciascun lotto: a) installazione degli erogatori, comprensiva dei collegamenti elettrici e idrici (adduzione e scarico) ai punti predisposti dalla Rai da completarsi entro 15 giorni lavorativi dall’avvio del Contratto; b) manutenzione completa ordinaria e correttiva delle apparecchiature, comprensiva delle verifiche, controlli e revisioni periodiche (cfr. “Parte 2° Programma di manutenzione periodica” del Capitolato Tecnico), delle attività di sanificazione, della sostituzione dei materiali di consumo e delle parti soggette ad usura, nonché di ogni ulteriore intervento necessario ad assicurarne il corretto funzionamento in conformità a quanto previsto anche dai documenti di manutenzione rilasciati dal costruttore degli erogatori, da eseguirsi in ottemperanza alle vigenti normative; c) esecuzione delle analisi periodiche delle acque previste dal Capitolato Tecnico; d) garanzia, assistenza tecnica, movimentazione delle apparecchiature e sostituzione integrale degli erogatori nei casi previsti dal Capitolato Tecnico ed, in particolare, per eventuali spostamenti degli erogatori in altri punti dello stesso cespite e/o di altri cespiti su espressa richiesta della Rai; e) interventi di miglioramento, adeguamento o sostituzione degli erogatori che risultino necessari per dare attuazione a modifiche normative o a specifiche richieste da parte delle autorità competenti; f) disinstallazione, spostamento, rimozione e ritiro degli erogatori al termine del contratto (o nel corso di svolgimento del Servizio quando necessario come da Capitolato) e contestuale ripristino degli spazi in status quo ante. Tali attività sono remunerate unitariamente mediante il canone contrattuale e non costituiscono autonome prestazioni principali. La fornitura si intende comprensiva delle certificazioni previste dal Capitolato e della documentazione tecnica attestante con chiarezza le modalità di utilizzazione, le specifiche tecniche, le modalità di installazione e le istruzioni di manutenzione nonché la conformità alla normativa europea vigente. Ogni prodotto deve essere corredato, ove presente, dalle relative istruzioni in lingua italiana per consentire un uso corretto ed in condizioni di sicurezza dello stesso e dalla garanzia del produttore. L’Appaltatore è, pertanto, tenuto, a propria cura e spese, e con propria organizzazione ed attrezzatura, a porre in atto tutti gli interventi e le verifiche che le leggi impongono, i controlli, e quant’altro necessario, anche se non esplicitamente specificato, per il mantenimento in perfetta efficienza degli erogatori di acqua potabile oggetto dell’Appalto, assumendosene tutti gli oneri e le responsabilità secondo i termini e le condizioni previsti dal Capitolato Tecnico. Non sono previsti limiti di partecipazione ai lotti e/o di aggiudicazione dei lotti nei confronti del medesimo operatore economico.

title: Denmark – Construction work – GENERISK IV SAMT DOMICILER – TAULOV DRY PORT A/S
description: Ved nærværende udbud ønsker Ordregiver at indhente tilbud på projektering og udførelse af ”Generisk VI samt domiciler”, der er et lager- og logistikcenter som Taulov Dryport A/S opfører i området ved Hertugens Kvarter i Taulov. title: Netherlands – Road-maintenance works – Raamovereenkomst dagelijks en groot onderhoud elementenverhardingen en straatmeubilair 2027-2028
description: Aanbestedende dienst heeft tot doel een aannemer te contracteren die zorg draagt voor vakkundig onderhoud van alle elementenverhardingen die in het beheer zijn van de gemeente Gouda. Daarnaast maakt het leveren van een aantal andere diensten, zoals het inrichten en in stand houden van een wachtdienst, het verzorgen van onderhoud aan straatmeubilair en het afwikkelen van meldingen onderdeel uit van het af te sluiten contract. Hierbij is het de insteek van de gemeente om zoveel mogelijk de werkzaamheden over te laten aan de Opdrachtnemer, waarbij een goede balans tussen het ontzorgen van en het houden van regie door de gemeente het streven is. De aan te besteden Opdracht bestaat uit het uitvoeren van dagelijks en groot onderhoud aan elementen- en halfverhardingen en straatmeubilair binnen de gemeente Gouda, waaronder in ieder geval: • Spoedherstel n.a.v. spoedmeldingen; • Planbaar herstel n.a.v. meldingen; • Grondwerk t.b.v. onderhoudswerkzaamheden; • Leidingwerk t.b.v. onderhoudswerkzaamheden; • Dagelijks onderhoud elementen- en halfverhardingen (< 200 m2 per tracé/wegvak); • Groot onderhoud elementen- en halfverhardingen (> 200 m2 per tracé/wegvak); • Kleine aanpassingen, veranderingen en reconstructies openbare ruimte; • Herstel en incidentele vervanging van straatmeubilair en wegbebakening; • Opstellen verkeersmaatregelenplannen t.b.v. uitvoeringswerkzaamheden; • Toepassen maatregelen t.b.v. waarborgen bereikbaarheid. Daarnaast maakt het verzorgen van een wachtdienst, het afwikkelen van meldingen en het verzorgen van de benodigde vergunningen voor eigen werk onderdeel uit van de Opdracht. Het te onderhouden areaal verhardingen bedraagt circa 1,8 miljoen m2 elementenverhardingen en circa 52.000 m2 halfverharde wegen.

title: Germany – Engineering services – MPI für Geoanthropologie, Jena - Umbau und Generalsanierung zum Institutsgebäude von zwei denkmalgeschützten Klinikgebäuden - Fachplanung Technische Ausrüstung (Labor)
description: Der Leistungsumfang betrifft die umfangreiche Generalsanierung von zwei denkmalgeschützten Bestandsgebäuden (ehemalige Kliniken) mit Planung und Umbau zu neuen Verwaltungs- und Laborräumen für das Max-Planck-Institut für Geoanthropologie in Jena. Auf dem Flurstück 105 / Lessingstraße 1 befindet sich die ehemalige Urologie mit einem denkmalgeschützten Teil aus dem Jahr 1914 und einem Anbau aus dem Jahr 1991. Auf dem Flurstück 102/5 / Lessingstraße 2 befindet sich die ehemalige HNO aus dem Baujahr 1928. Die Gebäude sind jeweils 4-geschossig mit zusätzlichem teilbelichtetem Kellergeschoss sowie nicht ausgebautem Giebelgeschoss. Gebäude und Gartenanlage stehen unter Denkmalschutz; daher ist eine enge Abstimmung mit dem Landesamt für Denkmalpflege bzw. der unteren Denkmalschutzbehörde erforderlich. Das Institutsgebäude wird überwiegend aus Büroflächen und Büronebenflächen bestehen. Weiterhin sind Seminarräume, ein Laborbereich mit Lagerflächen, Serverräume und ein Decision Theatre vorgesehen. Der Laborbereich wird als gemeinsam genutzter Laborpool für alle experimentell arbeitenden Organisationseinheiten ausgebildet. Der hochinstallierte Experimentalbereich mit Laboren, Laborlagern und Servern soll im Anbau der ehemaligen Urologie untergebracht werden. Die niedrig installierten Büro- und Kommunikationsflächen werden im denkmalgeschützten Teil der Urologie sowie in der HNO untergebracht. Gegenstand dieses VgV-Vergabeverfahrens sind die Leistungen der Fachplanung Technische Ausrüstung (Medizin- oder labortechnische Anlagen) gemäß § 55 HOAI in Verbindung mit Anlage 15 zur HOAI 2021 für die Anlagengruppe 7 in den Leistungsphasen 2, 3 und 5 bis 9 sowie die im Vertrag und in dessen Anlage A beschriebenen Besonderen Leistungen. Das Projekt wird als BIM-Projekt im Open-BIM-Verfahren durchgeführt. Bestandteil des Auftrags sind außerdem die in den Vertragsunterlagen einschließlich Leistungsbild beschriebenen BIM-bezogenen Leistungen, Koordinationsleistungen sowie die Erstellung, Fortschreibung und Bereitstellung der Fachmodelle nach den vertraglichen Vorgaben. Weitere Angaben zur Ausgangssituation, Aufgabenstellung und zum Leistungsumfang ergeben sich aus Anlage 01 sowie aus dem Ingenieurvertrag Labor einschließlich Leistungsbild. Besonderer Hinweis betr. Bieterfragen aufgrund besonderer äußerer Ereignisse (z.B. Sars-COV-2 oder Ukraine Krieg): Bitte berücksichtigen Sie bei Ihrer Angebotserstellung etwaige mögliche bzw. erkennbare Beeinträchtigungen, z.B. in Bezug auf die Verfügbarkeit von Materialien und Produkten, Arbeitskräften, eine evtl. verzögerte Beibringung von geforderten Nachweisen, Auswirkungen auf etwaige Nachunternehmer etc. Fragen, die in diesem Zusammenhang auftreten, bitten wir rechtzeitig vor Angebotsfrist über das Nachrichtensystem der eVergabe zu stellen.

title: Germany – Research and development consultancy services – 10030774-Providing Technical Assistance on Industrial Decarbonisation, CBAM Readiness, Gender Inclusion, Pilot and Upscaling
description: India's industrial sector plays a central role in the country's economic growth, while also contributing significantly to energy consumption and greenhouse gas emissions. As India advances its climate ambitions, including the target of achieving net-zero emissions by 2070, industrial decarbonisation and energy efficiency have become key priorities for enabling a sustainable and inclusive transition. In this context, the Indo-German bilateral cooperation between the German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ) and the Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE), implemented by GIZ, supports industrial decarbonisation through energy efficiency measures. Acting as a service provider and implementing agency for German international cooperation for sustainable development, GIZ works with Indian and German partners on project implementation and delivering effective solutions that contribute to sustainable transformation. The cooperation between the German side and BEE builds on a long-standing partnership in the field of energy efficiency and industrial transformation. Over the years, the collaboration has continuously supported the implementation of the Energy Conservation Act and contributed to a range of initiatives targeting both large industries and Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs). While significant progress has been achieved, considerable untapped potential for industrial energy efficiency and decarbonisation remains, underlining the need for strengthened policy frameworks, innovative market instruments, and scaled implementation approaches. Against this background, the project "Energy Efficiency" supports industrial decarbonisation through four key intervention areas: (a) developing strategies for industrial decarbonisation, including in the context of the Indian Carbon Market; (b) supporting the design and implementation of incentive schemes such as ADEETIE; (c) promoting industrial energy efficiency measures through demonstration projects and awareness campaigns; and (d) advancing gender equality and social inclusion in the industrial transition. Through these interventions, the project aims to strengthen policy frameworks, market mechanisms, institutional capacities, and inclusive approaches for a sustainable industrial transformation.

description: Die Gesundheit Nord gGmbH (GeNo) ist der wichtigste Ausbildungsträger für Gesundheitsfachberufe und Pflege in Bremen und hat in der Bildungsakademie ihre gesamte Aus-, Fort- und Weiterbildung organisatorisch zusammengefasst. Ein privater Investor soll sowohl die Bauherrenfunktion als auch die vollständige Finanzierung des Projekts übernehmen. title: El-installatørydelser til Aalborg Universitet
description: AAU ønsker med dette udbud at indgå en aftale med en primær og sekundær aktør. Den primære aktør anvendes i følgende situationer: A. Arbejdsopgaver inden for El-installationer, jf. aftalens pkt. 3.3. B. Arbejdsopgaver inden for brandtekniske installationer, jf. aftalens pkt. 3.3 (dog ikke f.s.v.a delaftale for København) C. Årligt eftersyn samt service og vedligehold på forskellige typer brandtekniske installationer, jf. aftalens pkt. 3.3 Den sekundære aktør anvendes i følgende situationer i henhold til aftalens: A. Arbejdsopgaver inden for El-installationer, jf. aftalens pkt. 3.3. B. Arbejdsopgaver inden for brandtekniske installationer, jf. aftalens pkt. 3.3 Ydelser i henhold til Aftalen udføres som udgangspunkt ved den primære leverandør, dog kan udførelse af ydelser ved den sekundære leverandør blive relevant i følgende situationer: • Hvis den primære leverandør ikke kan udføre en ydelse som følge af forbigående forhindringer, såsom mandskabsmangel eller andet, kan bestillingen i stedet gå til den sekundære leverandør. • Hvis AAU har fastsat en tidsfrist for færdiggørelse af en konkret opgave, og den primære leverandør ikke kan tilbyde at udføre ydelsen inden den af AAU fastsatte tidsfrist, kan ydelsen i stedet udføres af den sekundære leverandør. • Hvis den primære leverandør væsentligt misligholder Aftalen, kan AAU ophæve Aftalen med denne leverandør, hvorefter den sekundære leverandør bliver den primære leverandør af alle ydelser i henhold til aftalen. De beskrevne situationer dækker over, at AAU ønsker en fast samarbejdspartner i form af en primær leverandør, som ikke blot kan udføre service og vedligehold af el- og brandinstallationer, men også kan anvendes til større opgaver inden for disse arbejder. AAU ønsker i tillæg til dette at have en fast samarbejdspartner i form af en sekundær leverandør, som kan sikre driften i tilfælde af, at den primære leverandør ikke kan dette – nærmere bestemt i de tilfælde, der er oplistet i aftalens pkt. 3.2. Aftalerne træder i kraft den 1. december 2026 og udløber uden varsel den 30. november 2031. Der kan ske forlængelse i op til 2 år. Kontraktstart den 1. december 2026 forudsætter, at der ikke opstår forsinkelser. Det kan derfor ikke udelukkes, at kontraktstart vil blive udskudt, hvis der opstår forsinkelser i relation til gennemførelse af udbuddet. I givet fald vil udløbsdatoen blive fremrykket tilsvarende.
